verdict.rationale: Kino AI is an agent-driven video editor, so versioning and rollback of automations is a fair question. The evidence covers video variants, review links for footage and timelines, and smart bins. None of it documents versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations or agent workflows. Video variants and review comments are adjacent features about edited content, not automation history.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
